I am farming 3.52 hectares of maize here in Arusha, and the land belongs to my family so I want to take good care of it. I cannot afford much chemical fertilizer at the shop this year, so I will use the manure from my cattle and goats to help the soil, and buy just a small amount of urea to top-dress when the maize is knee-high. I will buy improved seed from the agrodealer because the rains can be unreliable and the hybrid gives a better harvest. My wife and I will do most of the work ourselves, but for planting and weeding I will hire a few neighbors to help so we do not fall behind.
